t: A sleepy, thrifty chip with Bluetooth that powers SparkFun's Artemis boards.
steps: Buy a SparkFun RedBoard Artemis Nano or Thing Plus Artemis from SparkFun or a maker shop.
Get a USB-C cable that carries data.
Install the free Arduino IDE on your computer.
Add the SparkFun Apollo3 Boards package using its link in the board manager settings.
Pick your Artemis board and its port from the menus.
Open the Blink example and press Upload.
Try a microphone example next and watch the sound levels in the Serial Monitor.
meta: Open Board. From $9.95. A few stores.
